name: skill-grader
description: AI Skill Grader, inside Codex. At the start of each session it gives a plain-English read on any skill it hasn't shown you yet: what it can touch and what to check first. The in-session read is local; ask for the full hosted report on any skill when you want the detail.

interface.shortDescription: A plain-English read on what a skill can touch before you rely on it.
